file_probe_definition: write = authenticated FTPS STOR, RETR and byte-for-byte comparison. A failed cycle does not prove that no partial write occurred. Each file is a deterministic 131072-byte sequence derived from its basename. In three-node runs seconds_to_dns, read.s, write.s are successive durations. The initial write duration includes startup and retries.

postgres_three_single_attempts.outcome: No confirmed SQL write via HAProxy in 155 s after an earlier stop/start with dynamic container addresses. Patroni identified a new leader.

postgres_primary_loss_before_ddl_propaga.note: With 2 streaming replicas, the client created the receipt table and acknowledged two immediate SQL markers (100,101). After stopping the primary immediately, SQL on the new primary reported relation audit_receipts does not exist. No first post-failover write to that table in 155 s. See separate controlled lag experiment for causal proof.

five_node_ftps.method: Five logical failure domains on a single local Docker Desktop host and isolated DNS networks. Each failure killed etcd, Patroni/PostgreSQL, SeaweedFS (master, volume, filer, S3), and SFTPGo on two nodes together. Single dedicated HAProxy and client stayed online. Primary data access was FTPS, TLS hostname verification, protected data channel, fresh sessions, 128 KiB deterministic test payload verified with SHA-256. Test controller moved files.audit.test alias to a surviving endpoint and verified its DNS result. The real DNS provider, arbiter, external S3 and WAN were outside this experiment. PG and etcd TLS enabled; SeaweedFS internal traffic used isolated HTTP, same-node local S3. SFTPGo default admin auto-creation disabled, lab test user provisioned in shared PG using a test fixture. The total time includes DNS change and retry until concurrent old-file RETR plus new STOR/RETR + SHA. Successful retries may overwrite same test key; version counts unmeasured. Templates adapted for test ports, a Docker subnet, disposable certificates and credentials, SeaweedFS replication 200, master electionTimeout 10s, 80 thin 20MB volumes per node, file payloads out of Filer metadata, archiving off.
